svg.title: Physical architecture of the AI infrastructure stack
svg.desc: On the left, two dashed groups: natural resources conversion, holding energy and utilities and raw and processed materials, and device manufacture below it, holding the semiconductor ecosystem, with a summary of what flows out of them. In the centre, land, building, operations and security enclosing the AI data centre, itself divided into physical plant and machines — the on-site electrical and thermal plant and central compute — and data, models and software, holding data and knowledge, training and cloud inference, and cloud agent services. To its right, internet and telecommunications enclosing the connectivity layer. On the right, deployed robots and smart devices enclosing the embodied machine, which contains sensors, edge compute, local models, agent and control software, actuators and a battery and thermal system. Above them the physical world, which sends two dashed lines of primary energy and geological resources into the conversion group, receives the machine's actuators and returns sensor readings. Energy, materials and semiconductors also run to connectivity and to the machine along dedicated lanes beneath the diagram.
